SENG332
Software Testing and Quality Assurance
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
Lab: 2
This
course
focuses on the creation and evaluation of test suites for moderately sized
software systems, including regression testing.
Students
will learn to use and develop
writing tools, particularly automated testing tools, for software maintenance and
verification. The course also covers fuzzing, code reviews, and pair programming. Basic
concepts of software quality management and the economic impact of software quality
(both low and high) are explored, along with industry standards such as ISO 9001 and
software process assessment and improvement techniques.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
SENG331
